en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Retaining Ring · Sy:
Retaining Ring · Symbol R

Internal (Bore) C-Type Retaining Ring (R Type)

A C-type retaining ring installed inside a hole (bore), designated by the spec symbol R. It conforms to the KS B 1336 and JIS B 2804 standards and is used to prevent axial displacement of bearings and parts inside a housing or bore.
